verdict.rationale: Stark Bank's own homepage says company money yields 100% of the CDI with daily liquidity, so idle balances earn against a stated benchmark. That support rests on a single marketing line, with no documentation of how yield is accrued, credited or swept. Missing for 10: detailed rate mechanics (accrual, crediting cadence, opt-in or sweep process), an explicit statement of who keeps any spread, first-party documentation beyond the homepage claim, and independent corroboration.
